## ZT-01 — Secure Service Mesh

| | |
|---|---|
| Test ID | BDD-ZT-001 |
| Acceptance criterion | All demonstrator service-to-service communication is protected by the configured service mesh and untrusted paths are blocked. |
| Test type | BDD / integration |
| Gate | G3 - Protected-service vertical slice |
| Evidence | `evidence/bdd-zt-001/` |
| Automation status | pending |
| Evidence basis | none (pending) |
| Runner | godog |
| Scenario file | `features/go/mesh.feature` |

```gherkin
Given the service mesh is deployed in each target cluster with workload identities issued
When two in-mesh services communicate and a workload outside the mesh attempts the same call
Then the in-mesh call is carried over the mesh under mutual TLS AND the out-of-mesh call is blocked and logged.
```

## ZT-11 — OPA Gatekeeper

| | |
|---|---|
| Test ID | BDD-ZT-011 |

| Test type | Technical BDD / inspection |

| Automation status | pending |
| Evidence basis | none (pending) |
| Runner | godog |

```gherkin

The size of any additional information contained in the message does not exceed the size of the attestation report. |
| Test type | BDD / integration |
| Gate | G4 - Bidirectional inter-cluster trust |

```

| | |
|---|---|
| Test ID | BDD-ZT-031 |

```
